## EMPYEMA/LUNG ABSCESS

Empyema is usually a complication of pneumonia. Diagnostic thoracentesis is
recommended in most cases. Pulmonary or Infectious Diseases consultation is

____________________________________________

## Inpatient 

## Duration

The duration of antibiotic therapy for bacterial empyema is not well defined but
generally 4-6 weeks

## Empirical Treatment

Ampicillin-Sulbactam 3 mg IV q6h [M]
< OR >
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M]
< OR >
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]
Suspected MRSA:
< ADD > vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h [R] to an antimicrobial regimen above

 ------------------------------------------------------------------

## Oral Step down

Preferred:
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h [R]
<OR>
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h [R]
<OR>
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]
Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h [R,DI]
< OR >
Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]
